svg.title: A client returns to the unit after a cerebral angiogram through the right femoral artery. Which actions does the nurse include in the plan of care? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: Moving catheters through cerebral vessels can dislodge a clot, so the nurse does neuro checks to catch a new stroke, and watches the arterial site for bleeding or hematoma and the leg for distal circulation . Bed rest with the leg straight for several hours protects the femoral puncture; walking right away or flexing the hip can start an arterial bleed.
